structured_output.summary: Every behaviour criterion has a test whose assertion would fail if the criterion broke. I found nothing blocking. Gaps are limited to detached-mode edge cases, and I did not run probes for them. The two modified existing test files only gained tests; no assertion was removed or loosened.

findings.text: No integration test covers an h2 extended CONNECT stream with stream_detached across a reload, or detached streams with stream_close_delay set. The doc comment says the delay does not apply and that h2 streams keep the request.
A stream whose upgrade finishes after the old handler's Cleanup has run is registered too late and is never closed on removal of its upstream. No test covers this reload race.
No end-to-end test for stream_timeout expiring on a detached stream, or for stream_logs with JSON config. Both are covered only at unit level.
streamRegistry.count is used only by tests.
intercept.go is declared for the task but unchanged. The intercept 101 handling relies entirely on the responseRecorder change, so the declaration is unused.

coverage.note: Echo works after reload in Caddyfile mode; the JSON variant is TestStreamDetachedSurvivesReloadJSON.
The stream to the removed upstream is closed and the stream to the retained upstream still echoes.
TestStreamNotDetachedClosedOnReload covers the close on reload; this test covers the stream staying open until the delay elapses.
The skip_handshake case asserts no 'handled request' entry for /ws; the default cases assert one with status 101. Caddyfile parsing is covered by TestStreamOptionsCaddyfile.
Asserts a 'stream closed' entry in the access log at debug by default and at info when configured. It is absent without logger_name access.

After hijack, Write, ReadFrom and Flush return ErrHijacked, and WriteHeader is a no-op. Nothing reaches the writer. TestHijackedConnRawConn and TestResponseRecorderSwitchingProtocolsIsFinal cover the raw conn and 101 being final.
A WebSocket echoes through intercept with handle_response and is access logged with status 101. The encode path is covered by TestStreamThroughEncodeWithAccessLog.
A raw h2 extended CONNECT stream echoes data in default and detached modes. HTTP/1.1 detached upgrades are covered by the reload tests.
A repeated finish() does not double-count. The stream harness's assertAccounted checks single accounting per result: closed, timeout, error and reload.
The integration tests cover reload in both modes, h2 extended CONNECT, encode and intercept upgrades, and detached streams with access logging.
Unit tests cover the registry, Caddyfile and JSON options, metrics accounting, and post-hijack writer behaviour.
